en: Āsava-āsava-sampayutta-duka (The dyad of taints and association with taints)
Dependent on an outflow (āsava) and a state associated with an outflow, there arises a state that is neither an outflow nor dissociated from an outflow by way of the root condition … three.
Dependent on a state associated with an outflow but not itself an outflow, there arises a state that is neither dissociated from an outflow nor itself an outflow by way of the root condition … three.

Dependent on a state that is both an *āsava* and associated with an *āsava*, and also dissociated from an *āsava* but not itself an *āsava*, there arises a state that is neither an *āsava* nor dissociated from an *āsava*, by way of root condition (*hetupaccaya*) ... three. (Abbreviated.
Nine under root condition. (Nine in all cases.)
